name: Dead Planets [BOSS UPDATE]
desc:
ESCAPE THE GALACTIC APOCALYPSE - 2082

The Moon colonies have fallen. An alien virus turned settlers into the infected, collapsing civilization. The lunar surface is hostile, overrun. Will other planets see a similar fate...?

Your only objective: Survive.
Pilot your space truck across the treacherous terrain. Evade the roaming hordes. Call in the Hummingbird to get to safety. This is your final chance.

Inspired by Dead Rails and R.E.P.O.

Important Notices:

Zero Tolerance for Exploiting: Any use of exploits or cheats may result in a permanent ban.

Early Development: This game is in its early stages. Please expect bugs, missing features, and changes. Your feedback is valuable as we continue development.

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite if you want to see more updates and support the game!
